title: Test-invoke function
description: Test-invoke a function with a mock event payload. Sends the function configuration and test data to the plugin server for execution and returns logs and status. Use 'mock_async_functions: true' (default) to simulate external calls like fetch() without making real HTTP requests. To test config that is staged for review, pass 'use_draft: true' instead of a 'configuration' — staged secret inputs are used, so the test exercises exactly what publishing would ship.

methodDocumentation.text: Test-invoke a function with a mock event payload. Sends the function configuration and test data to the plugin server for execution and returns logs and status. Use 'mock_async_functions: true' (default) to simulate external calls like fetch() without making real HTTP requests. To test config that is staged for review, pass 'use_draft: true' instead of a 'configuration' — staged secret inputs are used, so the test exercises exactly what publishing would ship.
